recognize_zh: 周邊血液中數顆小至中型淋巴球，染色質濃縮粗糙，核輪廓不規則、帶淺切痕或凹陷，胞質極少；型態不如花瓣細胞典型，但這種不規則核小淋巴球在 HTLV-1 背景下符合 ATLL。
features: Small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with high N:C ratio
Irregular, knobby or notched nuclear outlines; one cell with an indented nucleus
Dense, coarsely clumped chromatin without visible nucleoli
Very scant pale blue cytoplasm with occasional small projections
Background red cells with rouleaux-like stacking and some crenated forms (likely artifact); platelets present
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several small to medium-sized atypical lymphocytes with scant cytoplasm, dense chromatin and irregular, notched nuclear contours. Classic polylobated flower cells are not present in this field. Red cells show stacking and crenation that are likely preparation artifact; platelets are adequate. The morphology is compatible with adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma in the appropriate clinical and serologic context, but is not specific; flow cytometry and HTLV-1 serology are required.

ddx.vs: Sezary cells show fine cerebriform nuclear grooves in small to large cells and a CD4+CD7-CD26- phenotype without HTLV-1, while ATLL is HTLV-1 positive and CD25 bright.
Small-cell T-PLL has cytoplasmic blebs and a TCL1A or MTCP1 rearrangement with CD7 retained, differing from CD7-negative CD25-positive ATLL.
CLL cells have round nuclei with block-like chromatin and are B-lineage CD5+CD23+, distinguishable by flow cytometry.
